import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 66;
    static int r, c, n;
    static long[][] comb = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[] cnt_a, cnt_b;
    static char[] s;
    static ArrayList<TreeMap<Long, Long> part, part_zero;

    static void compute_comb() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
            comb[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j)
                comb[i][j] = comb[i - 1][j - 1] + comb[i - 1][j];
        }
    }

    static long get_difs(int conf, int a_bef, int b_bef) {
        long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < c + 1; ++i) {
            if ((conf & (1 << i)) != 0) {
            ++b_bef;
            long aux1 = comb[b_bef - 1][r - 1];
            long aux2 = comb[n - b_bef][r] - comb[a_bef][r];
            ans -= aux1 * aux2;
        } else {
            ++a_bef;
            long aux1 = comb[a_bef - 1][r - 1];
            long aux2 = comb[n - a_bef][r] - comb[b_bef][r];
            ans += aux1 * aux2;
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

static boolean check(int conf) {
    for (int i = 0; i < c + 1; ++i) {
        if (s[2 * r + c + i - 1] == 'A' && ((conf >> i) & 1) == 1) return false;
        if (s[2 * r + c + i - 1] == 'B' && ((conf >> i) & 1) == 0) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

static void compute_second_part() {
    int limit = 1 << (c + 1);
    for (int conf = 0; conf < limit; ++conf) {
        int b_here = Integer.bitCount(conf);
        int a_here = c + 1 - b_here;
        long val = get_difs(conf, r + c - a_here, r + c - b_here);
        if (check(conf))
            part.get(a_here).put(val, part.get(a_here).getOrDefault(val, 0L) + 1);
        else
            part_zero.get(a_here).put(val, part_zero.get(a_here).getOrDefault(val, 0L) + 1);
    }
}

static long get_coef(int conf) {
    int i, j;
    for (i = 0; i < c + 1; ++i)
        if (((conf >> i) & 1) != (conf & 1))
            break;
    for (j = i; j < c + 1; ++j) {
        if (s[2 * r + j - 2] == 'A' && ((conf >> j) & 1) == 1) return 0;
        if (s[2 * r + j - 2] == 'B' && ((conf >> j) & 1) == 0) return 0;
    }
    int set_a = r - 1 + ((conf & 1) == 0 ? i : 0);
    int set_b = r - 1 + ((conf & 1) == 1 ? i : 0);
    if (set_a < cnt_a[2 * r - 2 + i]) return 0;
    if (set_b < cnt_b[2 * r - 2 + i]) return 0;
    return comb[set_a + set_b - cnt_a[2 * r - 2 + i] - cnt_b[2 * r - 2 + i]][set_a - cnt_a[2 * r - 2 + i]];
}

static void upd(Pair<Long, Long> ans, Pair<Long, Long> act) {
    if (act.first < 0) act.first = -act.first;
    if (ans.first < act.first) return;
    if (ans.first > act.first) {
        ans = act;
        return;
    }
    ans.second += act.second;
}

static long count_in_multiset(TreeMap<Long, Long> ms, long val) {
    return ms.getOrDefault(val, 0L);
}

static long compute_first_part() {
    int limit = 1 << (c + 1);
    Pair<Long, Long> ans = new Pair<>(1L << 60, 0);
    for (int conf = 0; conf < limit; conf < limit; ++conf) {
        int b_here = Integer.bitCount(conf);
        int a_here = c + 1 - b_here;
        long act = get_difs(conf, r - 1, r - 1);
        long coef = get_coef(conf);
        TreeMap<Long, Long> map = part.get(c + 1 - a_here);
        Long key = map.ceilingKey(-act);
        if (key != null) {
            if (ans.first >= Math.abs(key + act)) {
                long coef2 = count_in_multiset(map, key);
                upd(ans, new Pair<>(key + act, coef * coef2));
            }
        }
        Long lowerKey = map.lowerKey(-act);
        if (lowerKey != null) {
            if (ans.first >= Math.abs(lowerKey + act)) {
                long coef2 = count_in_multiset(map, lowerKey);
                upd(ans, new Pair<>(lowerKey + act, coef * coef2));
            }
        }
        coef = 0;
        map = part_zero.get(c + 1 - a_here);
        key = map.ceilingKey(-act);
        if (key != null) {
            if (ans.first >= Math.abs(key + act)) {
                long coef2 = count_in_multiset(map, key);
                upd(ans, new Pair<>(key + act, coef * coef2));
            }
        }
        lowerKey = map.lowerKey(-act);
        if (lowerKey != null) {
            if (ans.first >= Math.abs(lowerKey + act)) {
                long coef2 = count_in_multiset(map, lowerKey);
                upd(ans, new Pair<>(lowerKey + act, coef * coef2));
            }
        }
    }
    return ans.second;
}

public static void main(String[] args) {
    Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
    r = sc.nextInt();
    c = sc.nextInt();
    sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
    String line = sc.nextLine();
    n = 2 * (r + c);
    s = line.toCharArray();
    cnt_a = new long[n + 1];
    cnt_b = new long[n + 1];
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        cnt_a[i] = cnt_a[i - 1] + (s[i - 1] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
        cnt_b[i] = cnt_b[i - 1] + (s[i - 1] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
    }
    compute_comb();
    part = new ArrayList<>(MAXN);
    part_zero = new ArrayList<>(MAXN);
    for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; ++i) {
        part.add(new TreeMap<>());
        part_zero.add(new TreeMap<>());
    }
    compute_second_part();
    long sol = compute_first_part();
    System.out.println(sol);
    sc.close();
}
}
